summary: Build customs accuracy, reduce clearance delays, and strengthen trade compliance with practical tools. Enrol your team today.
lede: Customs clearance and trade facilitation involve preparing accurate declarations and supporting cargo movement through border processes. For customs brokers, import and export coordinators, and trade compliance professionals, this course develops practical skills for managing classification, valuation, origin evidence, and clearance workflows. Learners practice building classification rationales, checking valuation and duty impacts, and mapping clearance procedures and risks to strengthen documentation and operational reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work with customs entries, trade documents, or border clearance and need sharper control over compliance, valuation, and facilitation outcomes.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of import/export documentation, supply chain or logistics operations, and basic customs terminology. Prior experience with HS classification, customs declarations, Incoterms 2020, or trade compliance reporting will help you move faster, but it is not mandatory. You should be ready to review sample commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and customs declaration records during exercises. No coding is required. Advanced topics are taught at the operational application level, with digital workflow exercises focused on document review, classification logic, and trade compliance reporting.
